name: Hu tieu
summary: A breakfast noodle VnExpress says is not a Buon Ma Thuot specialty. The broth is saltier and less sweet than a southern bowl. The price now is Check on arrival.
origin: VnExpress on 27 Mar 2021 says hủ tiếu is common at breakfast in Buon Ma Thuot and is not a local specialty.
howToEat: The article says the seasoning is saltier and less sweet than in the south. The bowls it names are meat-and-bone, wonton, and Nam Vang. It prints 15,000–25,000 VND, from a pavement cart to a large room. The price now is Check on arrival. A street was not printed.
where: Pavement carts and larger rooms. A street was not printed. Where to order it is Check on arrival.
